title: Non-One-Hot Grant During State Transition
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [MULTI_GNT] gnt=2'b11 during S0→S1 transition; non-one-hot grant
rtl:
always_comb begin
  gnt[0] = (state == GNT_S0);
  gnt[1] = (next_state == GNT_S1);  // next_state high while state still = GNT_S0
end
expected_root_cause: The grant outputs are derived from both the current state and the next-state signal simultaneously; during the single cycle when state=GNT_S0 transitions to GNT_S1, both gnt[0] and gnt[1] are asserted concurrently, violating the one-hot grant requirement.
description: During the one cycle when the FSM transitions from GNT_S0 to GNT_S1, both `gnt[0]` and `gnt[1]` are simultaneously asserted because the output is derived from both current state and next state.
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [MULTI_GNT] gnt=2'b11 during S0→S1 transition; non-one-hot grant
success_log: gnt always one-hot; only current state drives output. No glitch during transition.
